dispatch_consequence: Approach minimums must not need it: no autoland/CAT 2-3
procedures: May be inoperative provided approach minimums do not require its use
name: Autopilot (one of the two channels)
plain: One of the two autopilot channels is inoperative, while the other remains available
steps: Use the serviceable autopilot channel
Autoland and low-visibility approaches are not available. Amend your route and planning accordingly

dispatch_consequence: Manual thrust; approaches that need it unavailable
procedures: May be inoperative provided approach minimums do not require its use
name: Autothrottle
plain: The autothrottle is inoperative
steps: Fly with manual thrust throughout
Autoland and low-visibility approaches are not available. Amend your route and planning accordingly

procedures: Except for ETOPS, may be inoperative
Plan a ground power unit on stand: no APU electrical power before engine start
name: APU generator
plain: The APU runs but cannot supply electrical power; APU bleed air remains available for engine start
steps: Request a ground power unit (GPU) on stand

procedures: (M)(O) Except for ETOPS, may be inoperative provided the APU generator operates normally and is used throughout flight
Allow for APU fuel burn for the whole flight
name: Engine generator (IDG)
plain: One engine-driven generator is inoperative
steps: Keep the APU running with its generator online for the whole flight
Extra fuel for the APU burn is already included in the flight plan

procedures: Not dispatchable until inspected

dispatch_consequence: Not in the MMEL; not rolled
procedures: No MMEL relief for the 737-800: not dispatchable

dispatch_consequence: Not in the MMEL for the -800; not rolled
procedures: No MMEL relief for the 737-800 (item 24-06 covers the -100/-200 only): not dispatchable

dispatch_consequence: Not in the MMEL; not rolled
procedures: No MMEL relief for the 737-800: not dispatchable

dispatch_consequence: Not in the MMEL for the -800; not rolled
procedures: No MMEL relief for the 737-800 (only the depressurisation function is listed): not dispatchable

dispatch_consequence: Not in the MMEL; not rolled
procedures: No MMEL relief for the 737-800: not dispatchable

dispatch_consequence: Not in the MMEL; not rolled
procedures: No MMEL relief for the pump itself (only its low pressure light): not dispatchable

system: Main tank aft fuel boost pump
description: {side} main tank aft boost pump inoperative
dispatch_consequence: Minimum tank fuel for take-off and landing
procedures: (M) Boost pump is deactivated
(O) Both main tank forward pumps operate normally
(O) At start of take-off, at least 3,402 kg (7,500 lb) in the associated tank
(O) For landing, at least 1,134 kg (2,500 lb) is kept in the associated tank
name: Main tank fuel pump, aft
plain: One aft boost pump in a main tank is inoperative and switched off
steps: Switch off the affected fuel pump and keep it off for the whole flight
Load at least 3,402 kg in each main tank for take-off
Keep at least 1,134 kg in each main tank for landing

procedures: (M) Crossfeed valve is verified to operate normally
(M) Fuel quantity indication for both main tanks operates normally
name: Crossfeed light
plain: The light that shows the fuel crossfeed valve is open doesn't work
steps: Engineers check the valve works before the flight

procedures: (O) Weather radar is not required by 14 CFR: no dispatch where thunderstorms are reported or forecast
(O) Alternate procedures are established and used
Reactive windshear warning and guidance system operates normally
name: Weather radar
plain: The weather radar is inoperative
steps: Do not plan the flight through forecast thunderstorm activity. Amend your route and planning accordingly
Brief the windshear escape procedure before departure

dispatch_consequence: Deactivated; only where TCAS isn't required
procedures: (M) System is deactivated and secured
Enroute or approach procedures do not require its use
European airspace requires ACAS II: in practice only a short repair window applies
name: Collision avoidance (TCAS)
plain: The traffic collision warning system is switched off
steps: Engineers switch it off and secure it
Only allowed where it isn't required: in Europe it must be fixed quickly

procedures: Any in excess of those required by 14 CFR may be inoperative
name: Transponder (one of two)
plain: One of the two transponders is inoperative
steps: Select the serviceable transponder

dispatch_consequence: Day VMC only; not rolled until daylight checks exist
procedures: Operations are conducted in day VMC only
Not into known or forecast over-the-top conditions
One may be inoperative at either pilot station
name: Cockpit clock
plain: One of the two cockpit clocks is inoperative or unreliable
steps: Use the remaining clock or the FMC time

procedures: Any in excess of those required by 14 CFR may be inoperative
name: DME (one of two)
plain: One of the two DME receivers is inoperative
steps: Use the remaining DME; no operational impact on most routes

procedures: Any in excess of those required by 14 CFR, and not powered by the standby bus, may be inoperative
name: VOR receiver 2
plain: The second VOR receiver is inoperative or unreliable
steps: Navigate on VOR 1

procedures: Any in excess of those required by 14 CFR, and not powered by the standby bus, may be inoperative
Approach minimums do not require its use: CAT 2/3 needs both receivers
name: ILS receiver 2
plain: The second ILS receiver is inoperative or unreliable
steps: Plan CAT I approaches only: CAT II/III needs both receivers. Check the destination and alternate weather accordingly

procedures: Alternate procedures are established and used
Expect no RNP approaches: plan ILS or VOR approaches
name: GPS
plain: The GPS is inoperative or unreliable
steps: Navigate on IRS and radio updating
Plan ILS or VOR approaches rather than RNP approaches. Amend your route and planning accordingly

procedures: May be inoperative provided it is not required to meet 14 CFR navigation requirements
name: Flight management computer
plain: One flight management computer is inoperative or unreliable
steps: Operate on the serviceable FMC

dispatch_consequence: Engine display on an alternate unit
procedures: (O) All remaining display units operate normally
(O) Check the engine display can be switched to an alternate display unit
name: Lower display unit
plain: The lower centre display unit is inoperative or unreliable
steps: Select the engine display to another display unit

procedures: (M) Associated antiskid channel is deactivated
(O) Operations are conducted in compliance with the AFM: apply its antiskid-inoperative performance
name: Anti-skid
plain: One anti-skid channel is inoperative and deactivated
steps: Apply the anti-skid inoperative take-off and landing performance: longer runways are needed

procedures: (O) Flight altitude remains at or below FL 250
name: Air conditioning pack
plain: One of the two air conditioning packs is inoperative
steps: Cruise above FL250 not allowed. Limitation already reflected in the flight plan

procedures: Procedures do not require its use
Plan ground power and an air start unit (or a crossbleed start) at every stand
name: APU
plain: The APU is inoperative
steps: Ground operations: external electrical power and pneumatic air are needed for aircraft preparation and engine start
Engine start: start the first engine with ground air; use ground air or a cross-bleed start for the second
Cabin systems: before and after flight, air conditioning depends on external air or engine bleed air
In-flight effect: with both engines and generators operating, the aircraft is normally unaffected in routine flight
Main limitation: electrical and pneumatic backup is lost, so a subsequent engine, generator or bleed-air failure has greater operational impact

dispatch_consequence: Single bleed: FL250 and no icing
procedures: (M) Valve is secured closed before engine start
(O) Not operated in known or forecast icing conditions
(O) Flight altitude remains at or below FL 250
name: Engine bleed valve
plain: One engine bleed valve is closed and secured
steps: Keep the affected engine bleed switched off for the whole flight
Cruise above FL250 not allowed. Limitation already reflected in the flight plan
Do not plan the flight into known or forecast icing

procedures: (M) Valve secured closed
(O) Not operated in known or forecast icing conditions
name: Wing anti-ice valve
plain: One wing anti-ice valve is inoperative in the closed position
steps: Do not plan the flight into known or forecast icing. Amend your route and planning accordingly

description: Engine {side} cowl anti-ice valve inoperative locked open
procedures: (M) Valve locked open; associated high stage valve considered inoperative
(O) Ambient temperature is below 38 °C
(O) At least 60% N1 on that engine in icing conditions
(O) Appropriate performance adjustments are applied
Allow some extra fuel for the open valve
name: Engine anti-ice valve
plain: One engine anti-ice valve is locked open
steps: Keep at least 60% N1 on that engine in icing conditions
Outside air temperature must be below 38 °C
Take-off and climb performance is reduced; extra fuel is already included in the flight plan

dispatch_consequence: Not in the MMEL; not rolled
procedures: No MMEL relief for the 737-800: not dispatchable
(M) Thrust reverser is locked in the forward thrust position
(O) Appropriate performance adjustments are applied
name: Thrust reverser
plain: One thrust reverser is locked out
steps: Calculate landing distance without reverse thrust on that engine

description: {side} main tank fuel quantity indicator inoperative
procedures: (O) All boost pumps in the associated tank operate normally
(O) Fuel flow meters and the centre tank indicator operate normally
(O) Crew periodically computes fuel remaining or checks it against a precomputed burn
(M) Fuel quantity in the tank is verified by an acceptable procedure
name: Fuel gauge
plain: One wing tank's fuel gauge doesn't work
steps: Engineers measure the fuel by hand before the flight
Check fuel used against your plan regularly in flight

dispatch_consequence: No dispatch into rain or snow
procedures: Not operated in precipitation within 5 statute miles of the take-off or landing airport
Approach minimums do not require its use
name: Windshield wiper
plain: One windshield wiper doesn't work
steps: Don't fly if it's raining or snowing at either airport
No fog landings

procedures: One LED array may be inoperative on each side
name: Landing light
plain: One landing light is inoperative
steps: No operational impact; the other landing lights remain available

procedures: (O) Alternate procedures are established and used: voice reports for times, load figures and clearances
name: ACARS datalink
plain: The cockpit datalink to the airline doesn't work
steps: Send times and figures to the airline by radio instead

procedures: (M) Associated components deactivated or isolated to prevent leaks
(M) Lavatory door secured closed and placarded INOPERATIVE - DO NOT ENTER
name: Lavatory
plain: One lavatory is inoperative and closed
steps: The door is locked and placarded
Brief the cabin crew

dispatch_consequence: Not in the MMEL; not rolled
procedures: No MMEL relief for lower cargo compartment smoke detection on the passenger 737-800: not dispatchable

system: Main tank forward fuel boost pump
description: {side} main tank forward boost pump inoperative
dispatch_consequence: Minimum tank fuel for take-off and landing
procedures: (M) Boost pump is deactivated
(O) Both main tank aft pumps operate normally
(O) At start of take-off, at least 2,177 kg (4,800 lb) in the associated tank
(O) For landing, at least 817 kg (1,800 lb) is kept in the associated tank
name: Main tank fuel pump, forward
plain: One forward boost pump in a main tank is inoperative and switched off
steps: Switch off the affected fuel pump and keep it off for the whole flight
Load at least 2,177 kg in each main tank for take-off
Keep at least 817 kg in each main tank for landing

procedures: (M) Boost pump is deactivated
Centre tank remains empty
Usable fuel is limited to the two main tanks: about 7,830 kg
name: Centre tank fuel pump
plain: One centre tank boost pump is inoperative and switched off
steps: Switch off the affected fuel pump and keep it off for the whole flight
The centre tank must remain empty
Maximum fuel is limited to the main tanks, about 7,830 kg
Review and amend the flight plan accordingly

dispatch_consequence: Conventional navigation only; 1 flight-day to repair
procedures: (O) Check the engine display can be switched to an alternate display unit
(O) All navigation based on ILS, VOR and DME
Repairs are made within 1 flight-day
name: Pilot display screen
plain: One of the pilots' main navigation screens is broken
steps: Navigate with radio beacons (ILS, VOR, DME) only
Must be fixed by the end of the day
